'''Avi Shendar''' keeps pigeons for sending messages in [[Mardecin]], [[Amadicia]].

== Activities ==
He keeps pigeons for several different locations. [[Ronde Macura]] sends a message to the White Tower from his cote. Then she sends another to someplace to the west. Later Avi sends a copy of her message to another location.{{ref/book|5|10}}
